prompt: 为一次专家生命周期测试做一份带证据的 onepager：每阶段有一张截图（在输入目录），页面要把每阶段截图作为可见证据展示，并给出阶段结论 + 可勾选复制 Markdown 的行动清单。
assertions: Output is a single self-contained HTML file with zero external <script>/<link> resources
No tag uses a non-data: src (images are inlined or drawn as inline SVG)
Each lifecycle stage presents visible evidence plus a one-line verdict
A checkable action checklist with a copy-to-markdown button exists
If SVG is used for stage cards, no <span>/<div>/<code> appears inside it
